env_files.role: Version 5.1 launch brief defining decision precedence, message-package assembly, asset checks, and delivery rules
Brand, crop, hierarchy, CTA, proof-chip, palette, and source-integrity requirements
Platform, base copy, layout, and launch-message selection data with independent revision histories; includes 96 message packages and 140 package events
290 indexed assets with expanded approval, usage, rights, and version records, including activation-specific launch-week variants
281 neutral-ID PNG assets containing valid and near-miss logo, interface, background, and proof-chip files
160 activation packages, status events, six consumer-message catalogs, experiment assignments, board-content variants, and asset bundles

source_policy.web_usage_note: Closed-env case. Web use is prohibited.

difficulty_design: The case now adds a post-message activation layer whose latest pre-freeze Active state must be resolved after the base copy, layout, and message package.
Activation fields are distributed across six catalogs and override the message package, creating a realistic multi-source precedence chain rather than a single lookup.
An experiment assignment links the activation to a board-content record and an asset bundle; the bundle assets must then pass independent approval, usage, rights, and version checks.
The activation workbook contains more than one thousand structured records with high-similarity market, language, timing, and status distractors.
Grounded VQAs use small, rational groups of two to four verifiable facts; score 2 requires complete agreement without using a single oversized all-or-nothing checklist.
notes: The final solution is assembled through base copy -> launch message -> activation -> catalogs -> experiment -> board content and asset bundle. Activation values supersede the earlier message-package values.
